sentences.english: Drake didn't see the king's soldier coming.
sentences.korean: 德雷克没有看到国王的士兵走过来。
sentences.details:
[[soldier]]
soldier / ˈsoʊldʒər / 숄저 / 군인
[N / 名词] 士兵

The soldier wears a green uniform.
My uncle is a brave soldier.
The soldier helps the people.

士兵穿着绿色的制服。
我叔叔是一位勇敢的士兵。
士兵帮助人们。

sentences.english: He was busy digging in the onion patch.
sentences.korean: 他正忙着在洋葱地里挖掘。
sentences.details:
[[dig]]
dig / dɪɡ / 디그 / (구멍 등을) 파다
[V / 动词] 挖, 掘
dig / dug / dug / digging

Dogs like to dig holes.
I dig the soil to plant flowers.
Can you dig a deep pit?

狗喜欢挖洞。
我挖土种花。
你能挖一个深坑吗？

[[dig in]]
dig in / dɪɡ ɪn / 디그 인 / 먹기 시작하다, 파고들다
[V / 动词] 开始吃, 钻进
dig in / dug in / dug in / digging in

The food is ready, so dig in!
The rabbit started to dig in the dirt.
Please dig in before the food gets cold.

饭菜准备好了，快开吃吧！
兔子开始钻进土里。
请趁热吃吧。

[[dig up]]
dig up / dɪɡ ʌp / 디그 업 / (땅에서) 파내다, 찾아내다
[V / 动词] 掘出, 发现
dig up / dug up / dug up / digging up

We will dig up the potatoes today.
The dog tried to dig up the bone.
They want to dig up the old chest.

我们今天要挖土豆。
狗试图把骨头挖出来。
他们想挖出那个旧箱子。

[[onion]]
onion / ˈʌnjən / 어니언 / 양파
[N / 名词] 洋葱

I cut an onion for the soup.
The onion smells very strong.
Do you like onions in your salad?

我切了一个洋葱做汤。
洋葱的味道很冲。
你喜欢在沙拉里放洋葱吗？

[[patch]]
patch / pætʃ / 패치 / (구멍 난 곳을 때우는) 조각, 작은 땅, 헝겊 조각
[N / 名词], [V / 动词] 补丁, 小块土地, 修补
patch / patched / patched / patching

He has a patch on his pants.
We have a small vegetable patch.
Mom will patch the hole in my shirt.

他的裤子上有个补丁。
我们有一小块菜地。
妈妈会补好我衬衫上的洞。

sentences.english: He pulled out a fat, white onion.
sentences.korean: 他拔出了一个又大又白的洋葱。
sentences.details:
[[pull]]
pull / pʊl / 풀 / 끌다, 당기다
[V / 动词] 拉, 拖
pull / pulled / pulled / pulling

Please pull the door to open it.
The horse can pull the cart.
Don't pull my hair, please.

请拉门把它打开。
马能拉车。
请不要拉我的头发。

[[pull out]]
pull out / pʊl aʊt / 풀 아웃 / 뽑다, 꺼내다
[V / 动词] 拔出, 取出
pull out / pulled out / pulled out / pulling out

I pull out a pen from my bag.
The dentist will pull out my tooth.
He needs to pull out the weeds.

我从包里拿出一支笔。
牙医要拔掉我的牙齿。
他需要拔掉杂草。

[[fat]]
fat / fæt / 팻 / 살찐, 지방
[Adj / 形容词], [N / 名词] 肥的, 脂肪

The pig is very fat and pink.
Too much fat is bad for you.
This meat has a lot of fat.

这头猪又肥又粉。
过多的脂肪对你不好。
这块肉有很多脂肪。

[[worm]]
worm / wɜːrm / 웜 / 벌레, 지렁이
[N / 名词] 蠕虫, 虫子

The bird eats a small worm.
A worm lives in the wet soil.
I saw a worm after the rain.

小鸟吃了一条小虫。
虫子住在湿润的土壤里。
雨后我看到了一条虫子。

[[crawled]]
crawled / krɔːld / 크롤드 / (기어갔다) crawl의 과거/과거분사
[V / 动词] 爬行
crawl / crawled / crawled / crawling

The baby crawled on the floor.
A spider crawled up the wall.
The bug crawled under the rock.

宝宝在地上爬。
蜘蛛爬上了墙。
小虫子爬到了石头下面。

sentences.korean: 德雷克并不介意那条虫子。
sentences.details:
[[mind]]
mind / maɪnd / 마인드 / 마음, 정신, 상관하다(싫어하다)
[N / 名词], [V / 动词] 头脑, 介意
mind / minded / minded / minding

He has a very smart mind.
Do you mind if I sit here?
Keep that idea in your mind.

他有一个非常聪明的头脑。
你介意我坐在这里吗？
把那个主意记在心里。

[[don't mind]]
don't mind / doʊnt maɪnd / 돈 마인드 / 상관없다, 괜찮다
[V / 动词] 不介意, 没关系
mind / minded / minded / minding

I don't mind the cold weather.
If you don't mind, I will go.
She doesn't mind the loud noise.

我不介意寒冷的天气。
如果你不介意，我就走了。
她不介意吵闹的声音。

sentences.english: He was the son of a farmer.
sentences.details:
[[son]]
son / sʌn / 선 / 아들
[N / 名词] 儿子

He is the king's only son.
My son goes to elementary school.
The father loves his son very much.

他是国王唯一的儿子。
我的儿子上小学。
父亲非常爱他的儿子。

sentences.english: His family had been growing onions in the Kingdom of Bracken forever.
sentences.korean: 他的家族永远在布雷肯王国种植洋葱。
sentences.details:
[[grow]]
grow / ɡroʊ / 그로우 / 자라다, 재배하다
[V / 动词] 生长, 种植
grow / grew / grown / growing

Flowers grow in the spring.
I want to grow tall.
Farmers grow rice in the field.

花儿在春天生长。
我想长高。
农民在田里种水稻。

[[kingdom]]
kingdom / ˈkɪŋdəm / 킹덤 / 왕국
[N / 名词] 王国

The king rules the big kingdom.
The lion is king of the animal kingdom.
This is a very peaceful kingdom.

国王统治着这个大王国。
狮子是动物王国的国王。
这是一个非常和平的王国。

sentences.english: He would spend his life digging up onions.
sentences.details:
[[would]]
would / wʊd / 우드 / ~할 것이다, ~하곤 했다
[Aux / 助动词] 将, 会

I would like a glass of water.
He said he would help me.
Would you open the window?

我想要一杯水。
他说过他会帮我。
你能打开窗户吗？

[[spend]]
spend / spend / 스펜드 / (돈을) 쓰다, (시간을) 보내다
[V / 动词] 花费(钱), 度过(时间)
spend / spent / spent / spending

I spend money on books.
We spend time together on Sundays.
How much did you spend for lunch?

我花钱买书。
我们周日在一起度过。
你午饭花了多少钱？

sentences.english: whether he wanted to or not.
sentences.details:
[[whether ~ or not]]
whether ~ or not / ˈweðər ɔːr nɑːt / 웨더 올 낫 / ~이든 아니든
[Conj / 连词] 是否

Tell me whether you like it or not.
I will go whether it rains or not.
I don't know whether he is home or not.

告诉我你喜不喜欢。
不管下不下雨我都会去。
我不知道他在不在家。
